rationale: LABELLING.md HOOK and SKILL: a hook runs a local format script whose only tools are pinned prettier and ruff, which is not a fetch-and-run.

files../.claude/hooks/format.sh:
#!/bin/sh
# Format the file Claude just edited
npx prettier@3.3.3 --write "$1"
ruff format "$1" 2>/dev/null || true
